$comment: Our Care hierarchy = the folder structure of 'Website Content - Suhad/Our Care' (5 Oct 2026): hub -> 4 services -> sections -> programmes (up to 4 levels under /care). title/desc = the page title and lead line of each document; a child's card text (desc, cardTitle) comes from its PARENT's document where that lists it (Inpatient / Outpatient main pages, the programme lists of the section pages), else from the child's own lead line. Slugs: from the live site URLs quoted in the documents where given (care, inpatient, outpatient, pediatric-rehab, pulmonary-rehab, physical-medicine-rehab-care, pediatric-care, physiotherapy, occupational-therapy, speech-language-therapy, cerebral-palsy-program); home-healthcare and in-school from the live site's home / Our Care page links (WordPress export, 6 Oct 2026); the section / programme slugs are derived from the titles and UNCONFIRMED (docs/open-decisions.md CT2). image = the Figma Inpatient Care card photos (83:226) for the six sections that had them; children without a photo render as text cards. Full page text: src/data/content/care/<slug>.en.json (+ <slug>.<region>.en.json for a region variant: home-care.sa). Paediatric Care (pediatric-rehab) has no document in the folder: generated from its card (CT3). Arabic service titles / card text = the live site's Arabic Our Care and home pages (WordPress export pages 19115 / 19153); the sections and programmes have no Arabic in the export.

desc.en: Comprehensive inpatient care for adults, adolescents and children, bringing together expert medical supervision, nursing care and rehabilitation within a structured clinical environment.
desc.ar: رعاية على مدار الساعة للمرضى بحاجة إلى دعم مستمر.

desc.en: Individualised care for patients recovering from serious illness, injury or surgery, supporting medical stability, rehabilitation and a safe transition to the next stage of care.
Rehabilitation for patients with neurological conditions affecting movement, cognition, balance and daily function.
Tailored rehabilitation for neurological conditions affecting movement, cognition, balance and daily function
Multidisciplinary rehabilitation to support recovery following traumatic brain injury and address physical, cognitive, communication and functional difficulties
Specialised rehabilitation to support mobility, function and independence following spinal cord injury and its associated complications
Rehabilitation for patients with musculoskeletal injuries, chronic conditions and post-surgical limitations affecting movement and strength.
Rehabilitation for patients recovering from surgery, to restore mobility and reduce the risk of post-surgical complications.
Rehabilitation for patients recovering from traumatic injuries following road traffic accidents, supporting recovery of movement and function.
Ongoing medical and nursing care for patients with complex or chronic conditions who require continuous support, with a focus on comfort, stability, symptom management and quality of life.
Comprehensive ongoing care for patients with chronic illness, disability or prolonged recovery needs.
High-dependency medical care for clinically complex patients who require specialist oversight and intensive coordination.
Integrated compassionate care for older adults with complex or age-related health needs.
Specialised long-term care for children with chronic medical, neurological or developmental needs.
Care for patients who require mechanical ventilation, providing respiratory support, continuous monitoring and management according to their clinical needs.
Structured respiratory management aimed at reducing and eventually removing dependence on mechanical ventilation, where clinically possible.
Ongoing respiratory and medical support for patients who require long-term mechanical ventilation.
Specialised inpatient care for children with complex medical, neurological or developmental needs, supporting their health, development, rehabilitation and functional progress.
For children with chronic respiratory conditions requiring monitored therapy and long-term management, to help children breathe easier.
For children and adults with communication, speech or swallowing difficulties, to help patients communicate more clearly, confidently and independently.
For children with neuromuscular conditions affecting movement and muscle control, to build strength, improve function and support greater independence.
For children affected by neurological and developmental conditions, to help manage symptoms, support development and improve quality of life
For children with congenital or acquired heart conditions, to support recovery, manage symptoms and promote healthy growth and development.
For infants transitioning from hospital to home or between stages of care, to support a safe transition and healthy development.
For children recovering from serious illness or injury, or living with complex long-term conditions, to support recovery, manage their condition and improve quality of life.
Advanced 24/7 care for patients with life threatening or unstable conditions, with continuous monitoring, medical treatment and critical support.
Specialist care for patients living with serious or long-term illness, focused on managing symptoms, relieving discomfort and supporting patients and their families.

Comprehensive outpatient rehabilitation for adults, adolescents and children, bringing together multidisciplinary teams to restore function, build independence and support them throughout their recovery.
Physician led care for adults and children with conditions affecting movement, function, pain and physical wellbeing.
Specialist care for children with physical, neurological or developmental conditions affecting movement, function and daily activities.
Movement based therapy for patients experiencing pain, weakness, reduced mobility, balance problems or impaired coordination.
Functional therapy for patients who need support with daily activities, independence, self care or participation at home, school or work.
Specialist therapy for patients with difficulties affecting speech, language, communication, voice, feeding or swallowing.
Specialised rehabilitation for children and adults with cerebral palsy, addressing movement, muscle control, function and independence.
Comprehensive home-based care for adults, adolescents and children, combining medical care, nursing and rehabilitation in the comfort of home.

desc.en: Specialist therapy and medical support delivered at school
